checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same matte black bottle with cap and loop in every frame; the scene is unchanged.

must.item: Bottle visibly turns slowly through roughly a quarter turn
must.why: Only the cap loop changes orientation slightly. The plain cylindrical body shows no turn. The bottle drifts left and back, and the last frame looks like the first, so there is no clear quarter turn.

must.item: Bottle stays upright without melting or changing proportions
must.why: It stays upright. There is slight width and cap-size variation at 2.4 s, but nothing is melted or bent.
The table, window and chair stay put. The plant shifts a little at 2.4 s, probably because of the bottle shift or a small drift.
The file is 640x640 and 6 s long. It was requested without sound, and the agent did not verify the audio.

faults.what: The quarter turn is barely perceptible and is mostly a sideways drift. The bottle returns to nearly its start pose.
The bottle and cap shift and rescale slightly between frames, and the background plant shifts a little, which hints at a small camera or perspective wobble.
Slight AI softness and compression in the frames.

summary: The bottle and scene stay faithful and stable, but the requested quarter turn is barely visible: only the cap loop changes angle and the bottle drifts slightly.
